title: a cancellation that arrives after a task's last await has settled leaves its result
purpose: Observe asynchronous behaviour through causal events.

stdout.text:
main observed 42
cancel requested
worker observed 42
worker cleanup
worker returned 42, cancelled false

provenance.origin: authored for #739 from the #601 K2 probes; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #739, probe `20-late-cancel` (Bible 20.5): main cancels the worker after the child it awaits has settled; the worker has no later await, so it completes with 42, runs its defer and is not cancelled. With a later await the cancellation is delivered there (`cancel.after-await-settled`).
